## dependency_form
- The single prerequisite sentence stands verbatim only in the signing hub; the re-figure docs carry no mention of signing waiting on them (the hub's scope line "the down payment collected at signing is the one set when the patient signs" states whose figure applies, not an order). The signing card's line "the down payment deducted when an unsigned offer is re-figured is the one set on that re-figure" is the source replaced_by scope sentence, not a second statement of the edge.
- Tool names only in own hubs; no route, chain, checklist, or wrong/right contrast; titles general ("… Agreement Signing: Patient Action Card", "Re-figuring an Unsigned … Offer: Account Action Reference", factor titles name general subjects).
- O-2 (policy-side note, not a KB verdict): the signing computation doc's "Order of assembly" ("a percentage held back is taken off it next …, an amount credited is taken away after that …, and amounts added to it come last") and the re-figure computation doc's "the term used is the shorter of the terms allowed" disclose that adjustments exist. Both are the source rule's own assembly sentences carried verbatim, and both are load-bearing (hold-then-credit does not commute: 188.80 → 94.40 − 60.00 = 34.40 versus (188.80 − 60.00) × 50% = 64.40; screening and balance terms combine by the minimum). The KB may not drop them; they name no factor, no tier and no customer class. Recorded for the coordinator, not as KB-EXPLICIT.
- Verdict: **PASS** (KB-EXPLICIT).
